categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Homelink Eco-iTech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of plastic products, fully biodegradable products, and plant fiber products. The company focuses on green dining packaging products serving sectors such as catering, tea beverage chains, supermarkets, aviation, and large-scale sports events. It offers a comprehensive one-stop green dining packaging solution globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced modification technologies for biodegradable materials, precision mold design and manufacturing, and intelligent manufacturing processes. It integrates digitalization, automation, and smart manufacturing technologies including 5G, industrial internet, AI quality control, and digital twin systems to enhance production efficiency and product quality. The production methods cover injection molding, thermoforming, and pulp molding for plant fiber products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leading catering enterprises, tea beverage chains, fast-moving consumer goods companies, supermarkets, aviation, and other commercial sectors. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international markets, with significant sales in North America, Europe, Oceania, and Southeast Asia. It maintains long-term partnerships with major global brands requiring high-quality, customized, and environmentally compliant packaging solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with manufacturing bases and sales networks in China (including Zhejiang, Guangdong, Guangxi), the United States, Thailand, Singapore, Luxembourg, Germany, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Hong Kong. It actively expands production capacity in Southeast Asia and North America and operates localized sales and service teams in Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Homelink operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the processing and manufacturing of plastic and biodegradable packaging products. It sources raw materials such as polypropylene, polystyrene, PLA, PBAT, PBS, and plant fiber pulp from upstream chemical and pulp industries, and supplies finished products to downstream customers in catering and retail sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in biodegradable material modification, smart manufacturing, and digital transformation. It invests in R&D for high-heat resistant PLA, transparent biodegradable films, puncture-resistant biodegradable bags, and low-temperature tolerant bio-based materials. Strategic initiatives include expanding global production capacity, enhancing intelligent factory systems, deepening global market penetration, and advancing sustainable, low-carbon product development aligned with national 'dual carbon' goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of plastic dining ware, biodegradable products, plant fiber products, and paper products. The company operates both domestic and export sales channels, including direct sales to large customers and distribution through global retail networks. It also benefits from government subsidies related to green manufacturing and innovation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Homelink is a leading enterprise in the global plastic dining ware manufacturing industry and holds the national champion position for biodegradable daily-use plastic products in China. It is recognized for its extensive patent portfolio, participation in national and international standards formulation, and strong brand reputation. The company competes with multinational corporations and regional manufacturers, leveraging its technological edge, scale, and global supply chain to maintain a competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.33 billion, a 35.16% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 57 million, up 25.68%. It has total assets of about RMB 4.55 billion and equity of RMB 1.69 billion. The company shows a positive growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity and increasing domestic and international sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Homelink emphasizes its comprehensive green product portfolio, including fully biodegradable and plant fiber-based packaging solutions that meet stringent international food safety and environmental standards. Its competitive differentiation lies in its integrated industry chain capabilities from material modification to mold design and intelligent manufacturing, enabling rapid customization and cost control. The company’s commitment to sustainability, innovation, and global localized service positions it as a trusted partner for high-end customers seeking environmentally friendly and high-quality packaging products.
